name: Fool Me Once
source:
Amara Conti has spent the last few months saving the world and thwarting the efforts of the villainous Dark Moon cultist, Reyes. 

But now allegiances have changed and the two must work together to stop a greater threat - and maybe address some simmering feelings along the way. 

[From [url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/fool-me-once]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿玛拉·孔蒂在过去的几个月里一直在拯救世界，并挫败邪恶的暗月邪教徒雷耶斯的努力。

但现在效忠对象已经改变，两人必须共同努力阻止更大的威胁，或许还可以解决一些潜在的情绪。

[来自[url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/fool-me-once]itch.io[/url]]
